records.title: Ethical perspectives on deployment of large language model agents in biomedicine: a survey
records.reason: Springer Nature abstract (Introduction/Abstract): interdisciplinary survey of biomedical LLM-agent ethics, risk, governance and mitigation; no runtime/inference optimization method.

records.title: Spiking Manifesto
records.reason: arXiv abstract: proposes a spiking-neural-network coding/brain-inspired representation manifesto; not a method for improving inference of LLMs or serving existing LLMs.

records.title: OmniGuard: Unified Omni-Modal Guardrails with Deliberate Reasoning
records.reason: arXiv abstract: OmniGuard is a multimodal safeguard/guardrail model and dataset for safety classification/reasoning; its contribution is safety coverage, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Affordance-First Decomposition for Continual Learning in Video-Language Understanding
records.reason: arXiv abstract: continual video-language learning separates stable affordance tokens and plastic representations; this is continual-training/representation learning, not runtime efficiency for LLM inference.

records.title: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting Compression with Long-Context Modeling
records.reason: The primary text’s method compresses 3D Gaussian Splatting scene attributes using Morton serialization, long-context attention and autoregressive entropy coding; its compression ratio concerns non-language 3D scene representation. The linked lineage does not create a technical connection to LLM inference/cache or serving.
